title: Cover clean MCP exit after the close budget with stalled stdio
outcome: Cover clean MCP exit after the close budget with stalled stdio
acceptance: MCP close dogfood retains a case where a clean exit occurs after CLOSE_BUDGET_MS while stdio stays open; it records clean_exit_stdio_open, observes exit after the budget, and sends exactly one kill

completion.summary: Landed the late clean-exit stalled-stdio regression: simulated clean exit at 31 seconds after the 30-second close budget records clean_exit_stdio_open, an after-budget exit timestamp, no close, and exactly one kill request. Combined full gate passed; fresh independent acceptance 3f5ceb1f95ac4093857219900ba3b92c passed 1/1, citing the gate and criterion/landing notes. This tests callback ordering and the kill request, not real OS pipes or successful process termination.
